title: Haddock on ratatouille
summary: Haddock on ratatouille is a mediterranean dinner built around haddock fillets and aubergines, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Haddock on ratatouille into even pieces and toss aubergines with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of aubergines while you season haddock fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle haddock fillets and courgettes among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Haddock on ratatouille before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Haddock on ratatouille into warm bowls with the juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
